repair.title: Guinea Worm Nearly Vanished
repair.summary: Guinea worm disease fell from about 3.5 million human cases a year in 1986 to 10 cases in 2025.
repair.why_it_matters: A painful parasitic disease was beaten back mostly through clean water, education, and local surveillance.
repair.caveat: The last cases are hard, especially because infections in animals can keep transmission alive.
